description: Approved RFC/deprecation exceptions for the OpenAPI breaking-change gate. Entries must reference an approved Contract Change RFC or deprecation record before CI may allow a breaking OpenAPI contract change.

exceptions.approvedBy: bmsull560 (repo owner) via issue #1256 and the curated deprecation register; removal targets 2026-07-01 and 2026-08-01 passed before removal on 2026-08-10
exceptions.reason: Removal of overdue frontend-compat aliases (/v1/auth/register, /v1/tenant/settings) from layer4-agents.json per V1-PROVISION-001. Canonical replacements (/v1/tenants/register, /v1/tenants/current/settings) are unchanged. Frontend migration to canonical paths completed before the register's removal targets.

exceptions.approvedBy: bmsull560 (repo owner) via PR #1354 and ADR-043 / ADR-044
exceptions.reason: Hardened Clerk authentication endpoints (/v1/auth/authorization-snapshot, /v1/auth/clerk/tenant) in API Gateway: removed legacy request bodies on GET operations and aligned security scheme to Bearer JWT token verification per ADR-043 / ADR-044.

exceptions.approvedBy: bmsull560 (repo owner) via PR #1415 and Layer 3 Graph Alias Deprecation Policy (docs/contracts/layer3-graph-alias-deprecation-policy.md)
exceptions.deprecationRecord: docs/contracts/layer3-graph-alias-deprecation-policy.md (v2.5 deprecation window closure: removal of deprecated aliases label, type, confidence, relationship_type from layer3-knowledge.json)
exceptions.reason: Closure of v2.5 deprecation window for Layer 3 graph response field aliases (GraphNode.label -> name, GraphNode.type -> entity_type, GraphNode.confidence -> confidence_score, GraphEdge.relationship_type -> type) in layer3-knowledge.json per docs/contracts/layer3-graph-alias-deprecation-policy.md.

exceptions.approvedBy: RFC #1500 (add git metric completeness metadata to L4 AuditOrchestrator) via PR #1531
exceptions.reason: RFC #1500 adds two additive, optional fields to the L4 AuditOrchestrator Scorecard contract: git_metric_completeness (dict of GitMetricCompleteness) and git_warnings (list of GitWarning). Typing GitWarning with its structured per-field shape (code, metric, status, message, bytes_read and optional max_bytes/max_lines) introduces required_fields_added on the git_warnings items schema. Both fields are newly introduced by this RFC; the tightened schema is the RFC's intended per-field shape and carries no raw git output or contributor emails.
